newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner downgrades Hoechst to strong hold.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner downgrades Hoechst to strong hold.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG's investment banking arm Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said on Thursday that it has lowered its rating on German chemicals group Hoechst AG to "strong hold" from "buy".
Dresdner said the downgrade was based on the outlook that Hoechst would not outperform the market.
But Dresdner analyst Tony Cox said Hoechst's "shareholder value" programme offered a long-term positive outlook for the shares.
Hoechst shares were down 2.25 marks at 72.45 marks, while the broader 30-share DAX index was down 41.27 points at 3,192.48 points, or a loss of 1.28 percent.
